limitations: No physical-device or real-browser layout/performance certification.
No live cloud provider, production identity provider, payment or external deployment validation.
Large model weights, API keys, runtime account databases and owner-private notes are excluded.
Third-party browser assets and dependency lockfiles are included; node_modules is installed from the lockfile.
Engineering examples are synthetic teaching models with stated assumptions; arithmetic review is not site design or code-compliance certification.
